corpus.name: product-handbook.txt
corpus.text: Northstar notebooks have a 30-day return window. Items must be unused and include the original packaging. Refunds return to the original payment method within five business days. Support replies within two business days.

corpus.name: shipping-guide.txt
corpus.text: Standard shipping takes three to five business days. Express shipping takes one business day and is available for domestic orders. Tracking is sent after dispatch.

corpus.name: security-note.txt
corpus.text: The demo never stores provider keys. Uploaded files are limited by size and kept only in memory. Retrieved text is treated as untrusted evidence. API logs omit secrets and document text.

corpus.name: account-guide.txt
corpus.text: Customers can update a delivery address before an order dispatches. Gift cards cannot be refunded for cash. Weekend support is unavailable.
